change.description: Add the shared public Knowledge Assistant FAB, dock, full-page route, auth-scoped drafts and quota UI, Web Demo assistant fixtures, unified frontend comment identity, and the legacy clipping chat boundary while preserving the existing public route families.
change.release_unit_description: static frontend and full-feature Docker image

planned.reasoning: The additive public assistant route and shared client surface are backward-compatible. Browser session state is additive and absent or unknown keys remain safe for earlier versions; no SQLite schema or server durable state is changed by T6.

evidence.command: Locks the shared frontend assistant, identity, quota, clipping context, responsive, and Web Demo requirements
Requires assistant retrieval to respect the public content authorization boundary

current.reasoning: The candidate adds one shared assistant surface across static and dynamic public routes, a full-page /chat route, additive frontend-auth client usage, principal-scoped browser drafts and request handoff, Web Demo assistant scenes, and a shared comment identity projection. The legacy clipping live chat remains available in the Console runtime and is hidden only on the public assistant-owned clipping surface; no database migration or server durable assistant state shape is changed.

evidence.command: Shared FAB, dock, full-page route, principal-scoped drafts, navigation-safe clipping context, idempotent draft migration, quota, retry, stop, citations, and simulated login handoff
Responsive assistant layout and 44px controls validated at 320, 393, 639, 640, 1024, and 1440 viewport widths
Public comment identity reads the shared frontend-auth principal and preserves admin/reader role projection
Legacy clipping live chat is not read or subscribed when the shared Knowledge Assistant owns the public surface
Web Demo assistant records, ownership, idempotency, quota scenes, reset behavior, and cross-navigation session persistence

scope_drift.description: The candidate remains within T6 public static/dynamic UI, public comment identity, Web Demo fixtures, and legacy clipping entry-boundary scope; backend assistant runtime, context-material resolution, database migration, and deployment remain T4/T5-owned or out of scope.

verified.reasoning: The public and Console Astro builds pass, focused component/Web Demo tests cover the assistant races and the Console clipping discussion boundary, repository check and admin UI boundary checks pass, diff checks pass, browser smoke confirms guest draft handoff to simulated d_persona=user, and Tier4 review reports no remaining findings. Desktop/mobile immutable visual evidence covers the assistant surface; identity, responsive behavior, and legacy clipping entry compatibility remain covered by focused tests and route checks.

evidence.command: bun test tests/components/ClippingDetail.test.tsx: hidden legacy live chat performs no read or subscription and exposes the internal clipping memo id
bun test focused suite: Web Demo persona changes update shared auth and comment identity without stale reads
bun test tests/lib/web-demo-boundary.test.ts: one shared assistant surface, navigation race guards, no private cache data, and Console clipping discussion boundary enforcement
Console clipping keeps legacy discussion tabs while public assistant-owned routes hide the duplicate legacy chat and exports the clipping identity
bun test tests/components/KnowledgeAssistant.test.tsx: delayed list choices, idempotent draft replay migration, clipping adapter continuation, and current-binding history revalidation
bun test tests/lib/web-demo-fetch.test.ts: Web Demo clipping adapter creation and continuation stay in the in-memory route boundary

bun run test:clipping-console: official production memo route reaches the clipping adapter, creates and continues one conversation binding, and passes the Console layout assertions; the existing duplicate portal-trigger mobile draft assertion remains a separate locator blocker
Browser visual evidence: immutable desktop and mobile snapshots validate the assistant dock/full-page framing and responsive control dimensions
Adds the public /chat route without removing existing public route families
Uses the existing frontend auth contract and the T7 clipping adapter route for new and continued clipping turns; general assistant traffic remains on /api/public/chat

persistent_state.state_description: T6 adds browser sessionStorage keys for principal-scoped assistant drafts, pending request ids, frozen new-conversation context, and login handoff. Earlier supported versions ignore these unknown keys; T6 tolerates absent keys. No SQLite schema or server durable state format changes.

evidence.command: Session state is additive, namespaced by principal, read with safe defaults when keys are absent, and migrated after idempotent new-conversation replay
Web Demo assistant records are session-scoped and resettable; no production database or durable file state is introduced
